SENIOR CITIZENS COMMISSION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  SAN
  DIMAS  Thursday, March 7, 2024 at 6: 00 P. M.
  201 E. Bonita Avenue
  1960

  Senior Center/ Community Center

1.  Call to Order and Flag Salute

Senior Citizens Commission meeting was called to order by the Chairperson, Wally
Nikowitz at 6: 01 p. m.

2.  Roll Call

Present:  Chairperson, Wally Nikowitz
  Vice Chairperson, Nancy Brewster
  Commissioner, Sandra Martinez
  Commissioner,  Rita Karasik- McGee
  Commissioner, Bill Beebe

Also Present:
  Emmett Badar, Mayor
  John Ebiner, Councilmember
  Chris Constantin, City Manager
  Jay Jones, Recreation Manager
  Dominique  Borba,  Recreation  Supervisor
  Orlando  Soto, Recreation  Coordinator
  Alexis Luna, Departmental  Assistant
  Sean Cazares,  Senior Citizens Advisor
  Pam Johnson, Senior Citizens Advisor

Absent:
  N/ A

3.  Presentations

Presentation from the YWCA San Gabriel agency on the different services they provide
to the San Dimas Senior Center.

4.  Oral Communication

None.
 Senior Citizens Commission  Minutes
March 7, 2024  Page 2

5.  Consent Calendar

Chairperson Nikowitz moved to approve the Senior Commission special meeting
minutes of July 20, 2023, seconded by Commissioner Beebe and approved
unanimously.

Chairperson Nikowitz moved to approve the Senior Commission meeting minutes of
January 4, 2024, seconded by Vice Chairperson Brewster and approved unanimously.

6.  Staff Report

Mr. Soto  reported the monthly attendance numbers for senior center activities. He also
shared the results of the lunch surveys that were conducted. There were positive
reviews on the food and YWCA staff. Mr. Soto shared that San Dimas High School
students were going to be starting a Silver Surfers Tech Club where they help seniors
understanding their electronics. This group would be meeting on the last Friday of the
month.

Ms. Borba reviewed and shared the financial statement report.

Ms. Luna presented the Senior Center' s " Resource Book" where seniors can find
resources to utility discounts. She also discussed future excursions and upcoming
seminars.

7.  New Business

8.  Senior Citizen Foundation

 None.

9.  Continued Items

Chairperson Nikowitz addressed that the Art Room Remodel Project was on hold and
opened the floor for any suggestions.

Vice Chairperson Brewster noted that she was pleased that the chairs in the art room
were replaced since they are more suited for the tables and participants.

 10.  Written Communication
 Senior Citizens Commission  Minutes
March 7, 2024  Page 3

None at this time.

11.  Future Agenda Items

A special meeting will be held on March 19, 2024 at 5: 30 pm to vote for the Older
American Honoree. Chairperson Nikowitz motioned it and it was seconded by
Chairperson McGee.

12.  Report of Members

Chairperson Nikowitz shared a book and a story and was glad to see a nomination for
Wayne who is the group leader of the Writer's Workshop. He encouraged for the
creation of more senior groups.

Vice Chairperson Brewster shared on the progress of the San Dimas Travel Club. She
stated that there were 19 people in attendance for the February meeting. She is working
with senior center staff to finalize the summer excursions based on the surveys
conducted.

Commissioner Beebe stated that he was happy with the outcome of the election and
shared that he had hosted a meeting at the mobile home park.

Chairperson Martinez reported on the progress of new seminars and resources she is
working with Mr. Soto.

13.  Adjournment

The meeting was adjourned by Chairperson, Wally Nikowitz at 7: 12 p. m. and second by
Commissioner Beebe.  The next scheduled Special Commission meeting will be on
March 19, 2024 at 5: 30 P. M.

P
  Q WyA
Departmental Assistant

1.  Call to Order and Flag Salute

Senior Citizens Commission special meeting was called to order by the Chairperson,
Wally Nikowitz at 5: 30 p. m.

2.  Roll Call

Present:  Chairperson, Wally Nikowitz
  Vice Chairperson, Nancy Brewster
  Commissioner, Bill Beebe
  Commissioner, Rita Karasik- McGee

Also Present:
  Scott Wasserman, Parks and Recreation Director
  Jay Jones, Recreation Manager
  Dominique Borba, Recreation Supervisor
  Orlando Soto, Recreation Coordinator
  Alexis Luna, Departmental Assistant
  Pam Johnson,  Senior Citizens Advisor

Absent:
  Commissioner, Sandra Martinez
  Sean Cazares,  Senior Citizens Advisor

3.  New Business

The Senior Citizens commission  members voted on the Older American  Nomination.
Chairperson Nikowitz motioned to nominate Nancy Brewster as the honoree. It was
second Commissioner Beebe and passed unanimously.

4.  Adjournment

The meeting was adjourned by Chairperson, Wally Nikowitz at 5: 32 p. m. and second by
Commissioner Beebe. The next scheduled Commission meeting will be on May 2, 2024
at 6: 00 P. M.
